(a) Write an equation of the line tangent to the graph of $f$ at $x=3$ and use it to approximate $f$ (3.1).\\
(b) Use Euler's method, starting at $x=3$ with a step size of 0.05 , to approximate $f(3.1)$. Use $f^{\prime \prime}$ to explain why this approximation is less than $f(3.1)$.\\
(c) Use $\int_{3}^{3.1} f^{\prime}(x) d x$ to evaluate $f(3.1)$.
